checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Open hands rest beside body, palms down.
checks.feet: Supine body stays supported while straight legs alternate upward and downward in a small range.
checks.movement: Lie supine with arms beside body and palms down; neutral head on low cushion. Straight legs alternate vertically between 10 and 30 degrees above horizontal, four cycles in eight seconds, keeping back supported.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
